identity.title: Reframe evidence package as transitional post-run bridge

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: The accepted Runtime Evidence Package v1 currently reads like a durable portable interchange format, but its proven production role today is narrower: it is the post-run bridge used to move completed-run evidence into Ailuros while EverRun/Ailuros dogfood validates governance semantics before runtime-native control becomes the primary path. Reframe that lifecycle explicitly without changing package shape, validation, CLI behavior, producer compatibility, or 8090 normalization. The package remains a useful transitional ingestion contract, not an Ailuros product standard or an attempted industry evidence standard. Document a retirement trigger: once equivalent evidence is consumed directly at runtime governance boundaries, new product work must not depend on this bridge and it may be retired after compatibility needs end.
human_pressure.why_now: Current wording such as canonical, stable and portable unit of evidence exchange can turn a dogfood scaffold into an accidental product/API commitment and invite speculative standards work that does not improve a runtime decision.
do_not_misread: Do not rename or delete existing EvidencePackage code, CLI commands, files or schemas in this pack.
Do not change evidence validation, event semantics, projection semantics or governance judgments.
Do not implement TRACE, SCITT, attestation import/export, signature verification or a generic exporter framework.
Do not change or weaken 8090 external_evidence normalization.
This is a lifecycle and product-boundary clarification, not an immediate breaking deprecation of the bridge.
red_lines: No production code, tests, schemas, fixtures, examples or app assets change.
No new adapter registry, exporter interface, verifier interface or external-standard dependency.
No compatibility break for current EverRun or other source-neutral evidence-package producers.
Do not claim that Ailuros owns an industry portable evidence or attestation standard.

machine_core.goal: Align the evidence-package documentation with its proven transitional post-run role and define its retirement condition while preserving the current contract and behavior byte-for-byte.
red_lines: The v1 package wire shape and required fields remain unchanged.
Existing readers, writers, validators and CLI surfaces remain valid.
Use canonical only for the current internal bridge contract when necessary; do not present it as a universal or industry standard.
The documented end state is runtime-native governance evidence flow, not a richer evidence-package product.
invariants: Evidence Package remains post-run and non-enforcing.
Current producer/source neutrality needed by dogfood is preserved.
Package provenance and deterministic identity semantics remain unchanged.
Ailuros makes no claim that package integrity or portability proves authority or permission.
Retirement is conditional on equivalent runtime-native evidence availability and compatibility needs.

producer.artifact: current accepted evidence-package documentation and live post-run EverRun/Ailuros bridge

observable_effect.assertion: Documentation consistently describes Evidence Package as a transitional post-run ingestion bridge, not the destination product or an industry evidence standard, while retaining the current contract unchanged.

proofs.assertion: The bridge is explicitly post-run, transitional and non-enforcing.
No package/schema/API/CLI behavior changes are introduced.
A concrete retirement trigger tied to runtime-native evidence is documented.
No external attestation/exporter framework is introduced.

failure_semantics: If existing documentation relies on canonical terminology for current package validation, scope the term rather than deleting contract language that tests or consumers require.
If a proposed wording implies immediate deprecation or invalidates existing producer packages, reject that wording and preserve compatibility.
Do not resolve this boundary task by changing production code.

steps.title: Record the transitional bridge decision
details: Create ADR-0006 explaining the current proven role, why it is not the destination product, and the retirement trigger.
State that external attestation/interchange standards are outside this contract's ownership without adding vendor-specific integration work.
State that post-run evidence remains valuable as dogfood and migration scaffolding until runtime-native evidence is proven.

steps.title: Scope the runtime evidence package contract
details: Update runtime-evidence-package-v1.md so canonical/portable wording is scoped to the current Ailuros ingestion bridge rather than an industry-standard ambition.
Keep Status Accepted because the bridge is still live; add lifecycle wording rather than marking it immediately deprecated.
Do not alter fields, validation rules, naming rules, provenance rules or deterministic identity.

steps.title: Align adapter and dogfood documentation
details: Make the adapter and EverRun dogfood flow describe the package as the current post-run bridge.
Document that runtime-native governance is the target integration path and package retirement is compatibility-gated.
Keep current CLI and post-run audit descriptions intact.

acceptance: ADR-0006 exists and states that Evidence Package is a transitional post-run bridge, not the destination Ailuros product.
The runtime evidence contract no longer implies Ailuros intends to establish an industry evidence interchange standard.
The package remains accepted and compatible for current EverRun/Ailuros post-run dogfood.
A retirement trigger tied to equivalent runtime-native evidence is explicit.
No code, schema, test, fixture, CLI or package-format behavior changes.
No TRACE/SCITT/crypto-attestation implementation or generic adapter/exporter framework is added.

must_check: ADR-0006 clearly records the temporary post-run bridge role and runtime-native retirement trigger.
runtime-evidence-package-v1.md keeps the existing package contract intact while removing any implication of an Ailuros-owned industry standard.
Existing EverRun/source-neutral producer compatibility and post-run audit behavior are preserved.
Canonical/portable terminology, if retained, is explicitly scoped to the current internal ingestion contract.
No source code, schema, tests, fixtures, CLI behavior or 8090 normalization semantics change.
No speculative attestation/exporter/verifier framework or external-standard dependency is introduced.
reject_if: The pack implementation renames, removes or breaks the current Evidence Package format or CLI.
The implementation introduces TRACE, SCITT, signing, attestation verification, a generic adapter registry, exporter or verifier interface.
The documentation still presents Ailuros Evidence Package as a universal or industry evidence standard.
The documentation marks the bridge unusable immediately despite current EverRun/Ailuros dependency on it.
Production code, schemas, tests, fixtures, examples, apps or forbidden files change.
